warning: These are optional, setting-compatible hooks, not claims about a mandatory canon storyline. Activate only when appropriate for the player's choices and established campaign facts.

hooks.title: The Two Princesses
hooks.premise: Anastasia and Isabel are building networks of capable supporters through academy relationships.
entry_points: A student receives two incompatible invitations.
A competition result makes a student's loyalty politically valuable.
A rumour threatens the reputation of one princess's allies.

hooks.title: Steel and Circles
hooks.premise: The Valenheart and Caldwin houses compete for prestige as leading martial and magical families.
entry_points: A public tournament pits students from both houses against one another.
A joint mission forces martial and magical specialists to cooperate.
A professor seeks a fair test that neither house can easily control.

hooks.title: Merit Against Lineage
hooks.premise: A capable commoner encounters barriers that the academy's official merit ideal does not remove.
entry_points: A ranking dispute reveals unequal access to training resources.
A noble offers support with strings attached.
A club must choose between a talented newcomer and a prestigious candidate.

hooks.title: Rumours at the White Rose
hooks.premise: A gala, club event or rumour network turns information into social currency.
entry_points: A rumour is true but misleading.
A source sells the same information to rival factions.
An event exposes a private connection between students.

hooks.title: The Unanswered Oracle
hooks.premise: Aria's reported oracle-related enrolment suggests religious interest in the academy, but the content of the oracle remains open.
entry_points: A second interpretation of a sacred sign appears.
A healer recognises a pattern tied to an unexplained event.
Dominus sends an envoy whose account conflicts with the official version.

hooks.title: A Trace from the Abyss
hooks.premise: An unusual magical disturbance suggests Miasma, but the source and motive are not initially known.
entry_points: A field team returns with a damaged mana circuit.
A harmless-looking object produces a corruptive reaction.
A pattern of missing supplies points towards an illicit ritual.

hooks.title: When a Celestial Appears
hooks.premise: The appearance of one of the Four Celestials should substantially change the stakes rather than simply serve as a cameo.
entry_points: A crisis exceeds ordinary academy staff.
A research discovery draws Ethera's interest.
A threat near the frontier attracts Carne or Seriel.
